title: Empowering Student Mental Well-being with AI: Intelligent Journaling, Emotional Insights, and Personalized Growth
summary: StudentSphere is developing an AI journaling tool that would give students emotional feedback, and an internal pilot at VIT is planned.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: StudentSphere is developing an AI journaling tool for students. The proposed tool analyzes journal entries, tracks mood, and offers personalized feedback. Its planned escalation workflow would involve counselors when high-risk content appears. An internal pilot at VIT is planned. Accuracy and response-time figures are development targets. No source reports an observed improvement in student well-being or a completed crisis intervention.
purpose: Support emotional awareness and timely access to mental-health assistance.

ratings.reason: StudentSphere is still developing the journaling tool and plans a pilot at VIT; its accuracy and response-time figures are targets.
